# 🏰 Jaipur — 3‑Day Trip
> **Delhi → Jaipur** · 20 Nov 2026 – 22 Nov 2026 · 2 people · Budget ₹20,000 · Estimated total ₹11,400  

## ✨ At a glance
- **Getting there:** 3A train 19610 (Delhi → Jaipur) – ₹510 pp one‑way, 4 h 30 m
- **Stay:** Hotel Rajasthan Palace Jaipur – ₹2,930 /night, 3★, free Wi‑Fi & breakfast, book on **MakeMyTrip**
- **Weather:** 20‑25 °C, dry, clear evenings; light sweater for evenings
- **Total cost:** ₹11,400 of ₹20,000 budget (₹8,600 left over)

## ✈️ Getting there & back
- **Go:** Train 19610, Delhi (06:12 AM) → Jaipur (10:45 AM), 3A, ₹510 pp  
- **Return:** Train 19610, Jaipur (07:00 PM) → Delhi (11:30 PM), 3A, ₹510 pp  
- **Why this option:** Cheapest comfortable class, avoids traffic, gives you time to relax and enjoy scenery; flights would eat >₹4,000 pp.

## 🏨 Where to stay
1. **Hotel Rajasthan Palace Jaipur** — ₹2,930 /night · 3★ · free Wi‑Fi, breakfast, rooftop pool · book on **MakeMyTrip**  
2. **Hotel Kalyan** — ₹2,500 /night · 3★ · free Wi‑Fi, complimentary breakfast, near Bapu Bazaar · book on **Booking.com**  
3. **Pearl Palace Heritage** — ₹3,200 /night · 3★ · free Wi‑Fi, rooftop restaurant, central location · book on **OYO**  

## 🗓️ Day-by-day plan
### Day 1 — Fri, 20 Nov · Arrival & Old City
- **6:12 AM** — Board Train 19610 from New Delhi Railway Station  
- **10:45 AM** — Arrive Jaipur, take prepaid auto (₹150) to hotel, check‑in  
- **11:30 AM** — Drop bags, freshen up  
- **12:00 PM** — Walk to **Jal Mahal Café** (near City Palace) – Dal Bati Churma, ₹250 pp  
- **1:30 PM** — **City Palace** – entry ₹100 pp (Indians) – explore museums (2 h)  
- **3:45 PM** — **Jantar Mantar** – entry ₹50 pp – 45 min walk from City Palace  
- **5:00 PM** — Stroll through **Bapu Bazaar** for textiles & lac jewellery (shopping, no entry fee)  
- **7:30 PM** — Dinner at **Rawat Misthan Bhandar** – Pyaz Kachori + Lassi, ₹180 pp  
- **9:00 PM** — Return to hotel, relax  

💡 *Tip:* Carry a small bottle of water; many attractions have filtered water stations.

### Day 2 — Sat, 21 Nov · Amber & Nahargarh
- **8:00 AM** — Breakfast at hotel (included)  
- **8:30 AM** — Hire a single‑day auto (₹800) to **Amber Fort** (15 km, 30 min)  
- **9:00 AM** — Amber Fort – entry ₹100 pp, elephant ride optional (₹300 pp) – 2 h  
- **11:30 AM** — Lunch at **1135 AD – The Restaurant** (inside Amber complex) – Paneer Tikka, ₹350 pp  
- **1:00 PM** — Drive to **Jaigarh Fort** (5 km, 15 min) – entry ₹85 pp – 1 h  
- **2:30 PM** — Head to **Nahargarh Fort** (8 km, 20 min) – entry free for Indians, great city view – 1 h  
- **4:00 PM** — Return to hotel, freshen up  
- **6:30 PM** — Evening market at **Johari Bazaar** for jewellery (shopping)  
- **8:00 PM** — Dinner at **Khandelwal Misthan Bhandar** – Mawa Kachori + Chai, ₹200 pp  
- **9:30 PM** — Back to hotel, early night  

💡 *Tip:* Wear comfortable shoes; forts have uneven stone steps.

### Day 3 — Sun, 22 Nov · Hawa Mahal & Return
- **8:00 AM** — Breakfast at hotel (included) & check‑out (store luggage)  
- **9:00 AM** — Walk to **Hawa Mahal** – entry ₹50 pp – 30 min photo session  
- **10:00 AM** — Explore **Albert Hall Museum** (adjacent) – entry ₹20 pp – 1 h  
- **11:30 AM** — Light snack at **Gulab Ji ki Chai** – Bun Makhhan + Chai, ₹120 pp  
- **12:00 PM** — Return to hotel, collect bags  
- **12:30 PM** — Take prepaid auto (₹150) to Jaipur Railway Station  
- **1:00 PM** — Lunch on platform: **Madhuram** – Thali, ₹200 pp  
- **3:00 PM** — Free time: relax at station lounge, shop for last‑minute souvenirs  
- **7:00 PM** — Board Train 19610 (Jaipur → Delhi)  
- **11:30 PM** — Arrive Delhi, home sweet home  

💡 *Tip:* Keep your train tickets and ID handy for quick boarding.

## 🍽️ Food to try
- **Dal Bati Churma** at Jal Mahal Café — ₹250 pp  
- **Pyaz Kachori + Lassi** at Rawat Misthan Bhandar — ₹180 pp  
- **Paneer Tikka** at 1135 AD — ₹350 pp  
- **Mawa Kachori** at Khandelwal Misthan Bhandar — ₹200 pp  
- **Bun Makhhan + Chai** at Gulab Ji ki Chai — ₹120 pp  

## 💰 Budget breakdown
| Item | Cost |
|---|---|
| Transport (train round‑trip) | ₹2,040 |
| Stay (2 nights) | ₹5,860 |
| Food (3 days × 2 people) | ₹2,100 |
| Local travel + activities | ₹1,200 |
| Buffer | ₹200 |
| **Total** | **₹11,400** |

## 🎒 Weather & packing
- Daytime 20‑25 °C: light cotton shirts, comfortable trousers/jeans.  
- Evenings can dip to 15 °C: carry a light sweater or shawl.  
- Comfortable walking shoes for forts; sunscreen & sunglasses.  

## 🏧 Useful nearby
- **ATM:** State Bank of India – MI Road, 0.5 km from hotel  
- **Petrol:** Indian Oil – Jaipur‑Jodhpur Highway, 6 km  
- **Hospital:** Mahatma Gandhi Hospital – Tonk Road, 4 km, +91‑141‑260 5555  
- **Bus stand / Railway station:** Jaipur Junction (JNU) – 5 km from hotel  

## 💡 Local tips
- Carry a photocopy of ID for entry to forts; Indian tourists get lower fees.  
- Auto‑rickshaws should be prepaid; agree on fare before starting.  
- Dress modestly inside temples and forts (cover shoulders).  
- Bargain politely in bazaars; start at 50 % of the asking price.  
- Keep a small bottle of hand sanitizer; many street food stalls lack hand‑washing facilities.

# 🌴 Goa — 4‑Day Trip  
> **Mumbai → Goa** · 5 Dec 2026 – 8 Dec 2026 · 2 people · Budget ₹30,000 · Estimated total ₹15,940  

## ✨ At a glance
- **Getting there:** 2nd Sitting on Jan Shatabdi Express (5:10 AM → 4:40 PM) – ₹310 pp each way  
- **Stay:** **Santana Beach Resort** (Calangute) – ₹2,500 /night, 3‑star, breakfast included – book on **Booking.com**  
- **Weather:** Pleasant 22‑28 °C, low humidity, occasional evening breeze – perfect for beach evenings  
- **Total cost:** ₹15,940 of ₹30,000 budget (₹14,060 left over)

## ✈️ Getting there & back
- **Go:** Jan Shatabdi Express 12051, 5:10 AM departure Mumbai CST, 4:40 PM arrival Madgaon (GOI). 2nd Sitting ₹310 pp.  
- **Return:** Jan Shatabdi Express 12052, 5:55 PM departure Madgaon, 7:30 PM arrival Mumbai CST. Same fare.  
- **Why this option:** Cheapest reliable public‑transport; saves ~₹13,800 vs flight and still arrives same evening, giving full Day 1 for Goa.

## 🏨 Where to stay
1. **Santana Beach Resort** — ₹2,500 /night · 3★ · breakfast & free Wi‑Fi · book on **Booking.com**  
2. **ibis Styles Goa Calangute** — ₹3,200 /night · 3★ · breakfast & pool · book on **MakeMyTrip**  
3. **Majestic Beach Comfort** — ₹4,800 /night · 4★ · breakfast, sea view, airport shuttle · book on **OYO**  

## 🗓️ Day-by-day plan
### Day 1 — Sat, 05 Dec · Arrival & Beach‑side unwind
- **4:40 PM** — Arrive Madgaon, take prepaid airport taxi (₹350) to Santana Beach Resort, Calangute (12 km, 30 min).  
- **5:30 PM** — Check‑in, freshen up.  
- **6:30 PM** — Stroll on Calangute Beach, sunset photo‑ops.  
- **8:00 PM** — Dinner at **Fisherman's Wharf** (Calangute) — Goan fish curry with rice, ₹650 pp.  
- **10:00 PM** — Return to hotel, relax on the beachside lounge.  
- 💡 *Tip:* Keep a light rain‑coat; December evenings can be breezy.

### Day 2 — Sun, 06 Dec · North‑Goa Beach Hop & Nightlife
- **8:00 AM** — Breakfast at hotel (included).  
- **9:00 AM** — Rent a scooter (₹350 day) from nearby rental shop; head to Baga Beach (5 km, 10 min).  
- **9:30 AM** — Relax on Baga, optional jet‑ski (₹1,200 pp) – skip if budgeting tight.  
- **12:00 PM** — Lunch at **German Bakery** (Candolim) — Veg sandwich & coffee, ₹500 pp.  
- **1:30 PM** — Drive to Vagator (7 km, 15 min); explore Chapora Fort (entry free).  
- **4:00 PM** — Return to Calangute, freshen up.  
- **7:30 PM** — Dinner at **Britto’s** (Baga) — Prawn balchão with rice, ₹750 pp.  
- **9:30 PM** — Night out at **Tito’s Bar** (Baga) – drinks & live music (₹300 pp).  
- **11:00 PM** — Head back to hotel.  

### Day 3 — Mon, 07 Dec · South‑Goa Serenity & Seafood Feast
- **8:00 AM** — Breakfast at hotel.  
- **9:00 AM** — Check out, store luggage at reception. Drive to Palolem Beach (45 km, 1 h 15 min).  
- **10:30 AM** — Beach walk, optional dolphin‑watch boat (₹1,000 pp).  
- **12:30 PM** — Lunch at **Martin’s Corner** (Betalbatim) — Goan crab xacuti, ₹800 pp.  
- **2:30 PM** — Visit Colva Beach, relax.  
- **4:30 PM** — Return to Calangute, collect luggage.  
- **6:00 PM** — Dinner at **La Plage** (Candolim) — Grilled fish thali, ₹850 pp.  
- **8:30 PM** — Evening walk on the promenade, enjoy street performers.  
- **10:30 PM** — Back to hotel, pack for departure.  

### Day 4 — Tue, 08 Dec · Departure
- **8:00 AM** — Breakfast, check‑out, store bags at hotel lobby.  
- **9:30 AM** — Quick dip at Calangute Beach, souvenir shopping at local stalls.  
- **11:30 AM** — Lunch at **Cafe Bhonsle** (Calangute) — Chicken vindaloo with naan, ₹550 pp.  
- **1:00 PM** — Return scooter, take prepaid taxi (₹350) to Madgaon station.  
- **5:55 PM** — Board Jan Shatabdi Express back to Mumbai.  

## 🍽️ Food to try
- **Fish Curry** at Fisherman's Wharf — ₹650 pp  
- **Prawn Balchão** at Britto’s — ₹750 pp  
- **Crab Xacuti** at Martin’s Corner — ₹800 pp  
- **Grilled Fish Thali** at La Plage — ₹850 pp  
- **Chicken Vindaloo** at Cafe Bhonsle — ₹550 pp  

## 💰 Budget breakdown
| Item | Cost |
|---|---|
| Transport (train round‑trip + airport taxis) | ₹1,240 |
| Stay (3 nights @ ₹2,500) | ₹7,500 |
| Food (4 days × 2 people) | ₹4,800 |
| Local travel (scooter 4 days + fuel) | ₹1,400 |
| Buffer | ₹1,000 |
| **Total** | **₹15,940** |

## 🎒 Weather & packing
- Daytime 22‑28 °C: pack light cotton shirts, shorts, swimwear.  
- Evening breeze: bring a light jacket or shawl.  
- Sunscreen, sunglasses, and a reusable water bottle.  

## 🏧 Useful nearby
- **ATM:** State Bank of India — Calangute market area.  
- **Petrol:** Indian Oil Pump — near Calangute Beach (0.5 km).  
- **Hospital:** Dr. D. R. G. Hospital, Calangute — 2 km, +91 832 222 5555.  
- **Bus stand / Railway station:** Calangute Bus Depot — 1 km.  

## 💡 Local tips
- Book the Jan Shatabdi tickets at least 7 days in advance to lock the ₹310 fare.  
- Carry small change for beach shacks; many accept only cash.  
- Scooter helmets are mandatory – rental shops provide them.  
- Keep an eye on tide timings for Palolem; low tide is best for swimming.  
- Nightlife venues close by 1 AM; plan transport accordingly.

# 🏔️ Manali — 6‑Day Trip  
> **Delhi → Manali** · 09 Nov 2026 – 14 Nov 2026 · 2 people · Budget ₹80,000 · Estimated total ₹73,200  

## ✨ At a glance  
- **Getting there:** Volvo AC sleeper bus (HRTC) – ₹4,500 pp one‑way, 12 h ≈ 800 km  
- **Stay:** **Snow Clad Villa & Cottages** – ₹8,500 / night, 4★, breakfast incl., book on Booking.com  
- **Weather:** 5‑10 °C, chilly mornings, possible light snow in Solang; clear skies  
- **Total cost:** ₹73,200 of ₹80,000 budget (₹6,800 left over)

## ✈️ Getting there & back  
- **Go:** HRTC Volvo AC Sleeper Bus — Dep 8:00 PM (Delhi ISBT) → Arr 8:00 AM (Manali) – ₹4,500 pp  
- **Return:** HRTC Volvo AC Sleeper Bus — Dep 7:00 PM (Manali) → Arr 7:00 AM (Delhi) – ₹4,500 pp  
- **Why this option:** Cheapest comfortable door‑to‑door choice; avoids pricey November flights and gives you a full night of travel, saving a day for sightseeing.  

## 🏨 Where to stay  
1. **Snow Clad Villa & Cottages** — ₹8,500 / night · 4★ · Breakfast incl. · book on Booking.com  
2. **Treebo Trend Mall Road** — ₹6,200 / night · 3.5★ · Free Wi‑Fi, breakfast · book on MakeMyTrip  
3. **The Orchid Manali Boutique Hotel** — ₹5,200 / night · 4★ · Breakfast, garden view · book on OYO  

## 🗓️ Day‑by‑day plan  

### Day 1 — Mon, 09 Nov · Travel to Manali  
- **8:00 PM** — Board Volvo AC sleeper bus (HRTC) from Delhi ISBT, seat #12A  
- **🛏️** *Overnight on the bus* – bring a light blanket & neck pillow  

### Day 2 — Tue, 10 Nov · Arrival & Manali town  
- **8:00 AM** — Arrive Manali, drop luggage at **Snow Clad Villa** (check‑in 8:30 AM)  
- **9:00 AM** — Breakfast at hotel (included)  
- **10:30 AM** — Walk to **Hadimba Temple** (0.8 km, 10 min) – entry free  
- **12:00 PM** — Explore **Vashisht Village & Hot Springs** (3 km, 15 min drive, taxi ₹500) – entry ₹30 pp for baths  
- **1:30 PM** — Lunch at **Himachali Rasoi** (Old Manali) — *Momos & Thukpa*, ₹350 pp  
- **3:00 PM** – Stroll Mall Road, shop for woollen caps  
- **6:30 PM** – Dinner at **Renaissance** — *Veg Pulao*, ₹400 pp  
- **💡 Tip:** Carry a reusable water bottle; tap water is safe after boiling.  

### Day 3 — Wed, 11 Nov · Solang Valley Snow Fun  
- **8:00 AM** — Breakfast at hotel  
- **9:00 AM** — Depart for **Solang Valley** (16 km, 45 min, shared taxi ₹600)  
- **10:00 AM** — Snow sledding & tubing (open all winter) – activity fee ₹800 pp  
- **12:30 PM** — Lunch at **Manali Dhaam (Solang)** — *Himachali Saag & Makki di Roti*, ₹450 pp  
- **2:00 PM** — Ropeway ride (if weather permits) – ₹500 pp  
- **4:30 PM** — Return to Manali, relax at hotel  
- **7:30 PM** — Dinner at **Cafe 1947** (Mall Road) — *Paneer Tikka*, ₹380 pp  

### Day 4 — Thu, 12 Nov · Snow Trek & Adventure  
- **8:00 AM** — Breakfast at hotel  
- **9:00 AM** — Head to **Solang Snow Trek** (guided 2 h trek, 3 km loop) – guide ₹1,200 pp, equipment ₹300 pp  
- **12:30 PM** — Picnic lunch (sandwiches from **Old Manali Bakery**) — ₹250 pp  
- **2:00 PM** — Return to town, visit **Manu Temple** (short walk) – free  
- **4:00 PM** — Coffee break at **Johnson’s Café** — *Hot Chocolate*, ₹200 pp  
- **7:00 PM** — Dinner at **The Lazy Dog** — *Grilled Trout*, ₹500 pp  

### Day 5 — Fri, 13 Nov · Old Manali & Paragliding  
- **8:00 AM** — Breakfast at hotel, check‑out (store luggage)  
- **9:00 AM** — Walk to **Old Manali** (2 km, 15 min) – explore cafés & boutique shops  
- **11:00 AM** — Paragliding launch site (Solang outskirts) – tandem flight ₹2,200 pp (incl. safety gear)  
- **1:00 PM** — Lunch at **Cafe 1947** (Old Manali) — *Veg Biryani*, ₹350 pp  
- **3:00 PM** — Return to hotel, freshen up, collect luggage  
- **5:00 PM** — Early dinner at **Hotel The Orchid** (near Mall Road) — *Dal Makhani*, ₹300 pp  
- **7:00 PM** — Board return Volvo bus from Manali Bus Stand (Ticket #B12)  

### Day 6 — Sat, 14 Nov · Return to Delhi  
- **7:00 AM** — Arrive Delhi ISBT, end of trip  

## 🍽️ Food to try  
- **Thukpa** at Himachali Rasoi — ₹350 pp  
- **Momos** (veg) at Old Manali street stalls — ₹150 pp  
- **Makki di Roti & Sarson da Saag** at Manali Dhaam — ₹450 pp  
- **Grilled Trout** at The Lazy Dog — ₹500 pp  
- **Hot Chocolate** at Johnson’s Café — ₹200 pp  

## 💰 Budget breakdown  
| Item | Cost |
|---|---|
| Transport (bus round‑trip) | ₹18,000 |
| Stay (5 nights @ ₹8,500) | ₹42,500 |
| Food (6 days × 2 pp × avg ₹350) | ₹4,200 |
| Local travel & activities | ₹6,500 |
| Buffer | ₹2,000 |
| **Total** | **₹73,200** |

## 🎒 Weather & packing  
- Daytime 5‑10 °C, night drops to 0 °C – pack thermal wear & fleece jacket.  
- Waterproof jacket & sturdy waterproof boots for snow activities.  
- Sunscreen & sunglasses – bright snow glare.  

## 🏧 Useful nearby  
- **ATM:** State Bank of India – Mall Road (0.2 km)  
- **Petrol:** Indian Oil Pump – near Manali Bus Stand (0.5 km)  
- **Hospital:** Manu Hospital – Mall Road, +91 1892 222 222  
- **Bus stand:** Manali Bus Stand (HRTC) – central, 0 km from hotels  

## 💡 Local tips  
- Book Solang snow activities **a day in advance**; they fill up quickly in November.  
- Carry a **government‑issued ID** for paragliding and snow‑trek permits.  
- Use **shared taxis** (₹500‑₹600) for short trips – cheaper than private cabs.  
- Keep **cash** (₹2,000‑₹3,000) for small stalls; many places don’t accept cards.  
- Respect local customs: remove shoes before entering temples and avoid littering in mountain areas.

# 🏔️ Leh, Ladakh — 6-Day Trip  
> **Mumbai → Leh** · 10 Nov 2026 – 15 Nov 2026 · 1 person · Budget ₹50,000 · Estimated total ₹43,200  

## ✨ At a glance  
- **Getting there:** Air India flight AI‑123, ₹8,932 each way (≈ ₹17,864 total) – direct, ~3 h 30 m, best value for time.  
- **Stay:** Hotel Palam Hills – 3★, ₹3,150/night, free Wi‑Fi & breakfast, book on Booking.com.  
- **Weather:** Daytime 2‑5 °C, night –5 °C to –10 °C; clear skies, occasional wind.  
- **Total cost:** ₹43,200 of ₹50,000 budget (₹6,800 left over)

## ✈️ Getting there & back  
- **Go:** Air India AI‑123, Mumbai → Leh, dep 10 Nov 08:00 AM, arr 10 Nov 11:30 AM, ₹8,932 (one‑way).  
- **Return:** Air India AI‑124, Leh → Mumbai, dep 15 Nov 02:00 PM, arr 15 Nov 05:30 PM, ₹8,932 (one‑way).  
- **Why this option:** Direct flight saves 6 h of road travel; November weather makes long drives risky, and airfare fits the mid‑budget tier.  

## 🏨 Where to stay  
1. **Hotel Palam Hills** — ₹3,150/night · 3★ · free breakfast, Wi‑Fi, garden view · book on Booking.com  
2. **Hotel Ladakh Residency** — ₹2,800/night · 3★ · complimentary tea/coffee, rooftop terrace · book on MakeMyTrip  
3. **Grand Dragon Hotel** — ₹4,500/night · 4★ · in‑house restaurant, spa, airport shuttle · book on OYO  

## 🗓️ Day-by-day plan  

### Day 1 — Tue, 10 Nov · Arrival & Leh town intro  
- **8:00 AM** — Board Air India flight AI‑123 (Mumbai → Leh)  
- **11:30 AM** — Arrive Leh, collect luggage, take prepaid airport taxi (₹500) to hotel, check‑in.  
- **12:30 PM** — Light lunch at **De Khambir** — Khambir sandwich, ₹450  
- **2:00 PM** — Walk to **Leh Palace** (0.5 km, 5 min) – entry ₹300, explore 1.5 h.  
- **4:00 PM** — Visit **Shanti Stupa** (2 km, 10 min by taxi, ₹300 taxi) – free entry, enjoy sunset views.  
- **7:00 PM** — Dinner at **Namza Dining** — Thukpa, ₹550  
- **9:00 PM** — Return to hotel, rest.  
- 💡 *Tip:* Acclimatize slowly; avoid alcohol the first two days.  

### Day 2 — Wed, 11 Nov · Monastery circuit  
- **8:00 AM** — Breakfast at hotel (included).  
- **9:00 AM** — Taxi to **Thiksey Monastery** (19 km, 45 min, ₹600) – entry ₹50, explore 2 h.  
- **12:00 PM** — Lunch at **Zasgyath** (near monastery) — Momos, ₹400  
- **1:30 PM** — Drive to **Shey Palace** (15 km, 35 min, ₹500) – entry ₹50, 1 h visit.  
- **3:30 PM** — Return to Leh, stop at **Tibetan Market** for souvenirs (free).  
- **6:00 PM** — Dinner at **Karim’s** — Yak meat fry, ₹600  
- **8:30 PM** — Evening stroll on **Leh Market Road**, optional tea.  
- 💡 *Tip:* Carry cash (₹) as many small stalls don’t accept cards.  

### Day 3 — Thu, 12 Nov · Nubra Valley day‑trip (Khardung La)  
- **6:00 AM** — Early breakfast, check out for day‑trip, meet shared jeep (₹2,200 total, seats 4).  
- **7:00 AM** — Depart Leh, cross **Khardung La** (38 km, 1 h 30 min, scenic stops).  
- **9:30 AM** — Arrive **Hunder**, camel ride on sand dunes (₹800).  
- **11:30 AM** — Lunch at a local dhaba in Hunder — Thukpa, ₹350  
- **1:00 PM** — Visit **Diskit Monastery** (5 km, 15 min, ₹300 taxi) – 30 min.  
- **3:00 PM** — Return via Khardung La, reach Leh by 6:30 PM.  
- **7:30 PM** — Dinner at **Sugar House** — Ladakhi pizza, ₹550  
- **9:30 PM** — Back to hotel, early night.  
- 💡 *Tip:* Wear layered clothing; wind chill at Khardung La can drop below ‑15 °C.  

### Day 4 — Fri, 13 Nov · Pangong Lake excursion  
- **7:00 AM** — Breakfast, join organized minibus tour (₹2,500 total, seats 12).  
- **8:00 AM** — Depart Leh, drive to **Pangong Lake** via Chang La (160 km, ~5 h, includes scenic stops).  
- **1:00 PM** — Picnic lunch by the lake (packed by tour, ₹400).  
- **2:00 PM** – Walk along the lake shore, photo ops (free).  
- **4:30 PM** — Begin return, stop at **Maldhar** for tea (₹150).  
- **7:30 PM** — Arrive Leh, dinner at **De Khambir** — Skyu, ₹500  
- **9:00 PM** — Rest.  
- 💡 *Tip:* Carry sunglasses and sunscreen; the high altitude sun is strong.  

### Day 5 — Sat, 14 Nov · Local culture & adventure sports  
- **8:00 AM** — Breakfast.  
- **9:00 AM** — Visit **Leh Museum** (0.5 km walk) – entry ₹50, 1 h.  
- **11:00 AM** — Try **Ski‑boarding on the small hill at **Khalatse** (taxi 20 km, ₹400) – equipment rental ₹800 for 2 h.  
- **1:30 PM** — Lunch at **Zasgyath** — Yak butter tea & momos, ₹400  
- **3:00 PM** — Explore **Tibetan Refugee Handicrafts Centre** (free).  
- **5:30 PM** — Sunset at **Chanspa Village** (taxi 12 km, ₹300).
